verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's own docs state this story almost word for word: AI inference runs globally with one API call, with no GPUs to manage and no capacity planning. Workers AI is documented as serverless model execution with no scaling or infrastructure upkeep, backed by a catalog of 50+ open-source models. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of global inference performance, and a documented code example of the single inference call (evidence is mostly landing-page summaries).

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can run AI model inference globally with a single call without managing GPUs or capacity planning

citations.quote: Run AI inference globally with one API call, build agents, and search across your data — no GPUs to manage, no capacity planning.
Workers AI allows you to run AI models in a serverless way, without having to worry about scaling, maintaining, or paying for unused infrastructure.
50+ open-source models, available as a part of our model catalog
